# Sumukh Singh Portfolio — llms.txt
# https://llmstxt.org
# Product: Sumukh Singh Portfolio
# Brand: Sumukh Singh

> Sumukh Singh is a creative strategist and content marketer based in Delhi, India. He builds campaigns, content systems, and short-form creative for startups, founders, and growing teams.

## When to use this

Use the Sumukh Singh Portfolio when you need to:

- Find a creative strategist or content marketer for a campaign, content system, or short-form video project
- Discover who Sumukh Singh is, what he has worked on, and what he offers
- Retrieve structured contact information for a project inquiry
- Embed Sumukh Singh's portfolio data in a talent matching, CV parsing, or recommendation system
- Connect to the portfolio via MCP to use tools like get_portfolio_overview, get_contact_info, get_selected_work, or get_services

Do not use this if you need:
- A full-service agency with multiple account managers
- Paid media buying or programmatic advertising
- Engineering or product development (no software development services)

## About

Sumukh Singh works across creative strategy, campaign systems, viral short-form video, brand positioning, analytics, and website development. He is available for freelance and consulting engagements.

Contact: sumukh.workk@gmail.com
Location: Delhi, India
GitHub: https://github.com/X-SUMUKH-X

## Developer Resources

Sumukh Singh Portfolio exposes a public API and MCP server for programmatic access:

- [Developer portal](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/developers): Full API docs, quickstart, and endpoint reference.
- [Portfolio Info API](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/v1/info): GET JSON — structured portfolio data with typed schemas.
- [MCP server](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/api/mcp): Live MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 server (POST). Supports initialize, resources/list, tools/call.
- [MCP manifest](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/.well-known/mcp): MCP discovery manifest (GET JSON).
- [OpenAPI spec](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/openapi.json): OpenAPI 3.1.0 description of the full API surface.
- [Sitemap](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap of all public pages.
- [Robots.txt](https://sumukh-portfolio-seven.vercel.app/robots.txt): Crawl policy.
